note: Installed upstream headers extracted from verified MSYS2 libc++ package; target __config_site replaced with Scratch configuration. No host SDK required to consume these headers.

local_patches.include/__config_site: Enable classic locale and default rune table; narrow streams, no threads/exceptions/RTTI.
local_patches.include/iostream: Request stream initialization only from a translation unit including iostream.
local_patches.src/iostream_init.h: Remove unconditional SDK-wide stream constructor; header requests Init.
local_patches.src/locale.cpp: Install classic narrow collate/ctype/codecvt/numpunct/num_get/num_put facets; named C/POSIX uses shared classic facets. Unsupported region names terminate in no-exception configuration.
